create_ConfigDict: create a ConfigDict instance from a dictionary to normalize and store configuration data
call_ConfigDict_with_fixed: call a ConfigDict with fixed config values to merge and resolve configuration priorities
call_ConfigDict_with_preset: call a ConfigDict with preset values to layer preset config on top of stored config
summarize_ConfigDict_call: summarize the ConfigDict call method that merges fixed, preset, and fallback configs into a ConfigSummary
review_ConfigDict_class: review the ConfigDict class that normalizes input dicts and resolves config via dogmatize and recursive_fill_in
